brief.aim: All six columns are distinct measured annual spend amounts (Fresh, Milk, Grocery, Frozen, Detergents_Paper, Delicassen) describing one customer each, which is exactly the entity-attribute profile used to segment wholesale clients into channel/segment groups; with no label column the table's evident purpose is clustering.
brief.repeated_subjects: No repeated-subject column; each row is one distinct customer with a single annual profile.
